say:1:1321825001:1.text: It's true... This isn't an illusion or a dream...
say:1:1321825001:1.source_cn: 是真的……不是幻境，也不是梦境……

say:2:1321825002:1.text: This must be a blessing of my ancestors... or perhaps this land is safeguarding our last heir in return for the blood our family once shed.
say:2:1321825002:1.source_cn: 或许瓦勒沙的先祖们依旧在庇护着我们……或许我们的家族曾...

say:3:1321825003:1.text: How remarkable! Everything has aligned as if guided by fate, and through this child, we witness a miracle. Who would have thought a flower could bloom from barren soil?
say:3:1321825003:1.source_cn: 真是神奇啊，一切的巧合就像是一个奇迹，而奇迹通过这个孩...

say:6:1321825005:1.text: You might be too young to understand this, but it means everything to our family.
say:6:1321825005:1.source_cn: 或许你现在还无法理解这一切，但这对我们的家族来说意义非凡。

choice_prompt:7:1321825005.text: You might be too young to understand this, but it means everything to our family.
choice_prompt:7:1321825005.source_cn: 或许你现在还无法理解这一切，但这对我们的家族来说意义非凡。

say:8:1321825006:1.text: ...Well, just like that whole ordeal with the false princess, I can't turn a blind eye when my own kin is involved.
say:8:1321825006:1.source_cn: ……我……就像我会请求你们处理掉玷污了家族荣誉的假公主...
say:8:1321825006:1.male: ...Well, just like that whole ordeal with the false princess, I can't turn a blind eye when my own kin is involved.
say:8:1321825006:1.female: ...Well, just like that whole ordeal with the false princess, I can't turn a blind eye when my own kin is involved.

say:9:1321825007:1.text: Honestly, I'm not sure what to do right now... I need some time to think it through...
say:9:1321825007:1.source_cn: 可我也确实不知道究竟该怎么办……或许我还需要一点时间来...
say:9:1321825007:1.male: Honestly, I'm not sure what to do right now... I need some time to think it through...
say:9:1321825007:1.female: Honestly, I'm not sure what to do right now... I need some time to think it through...

say:10:1321825008:1.text: Mr. Faramor, I'm tired, and this place is giving me the chills... Can you take me back?
say:10:1321825008:1.source_cn: 法拉莫尔，我……我有些累了，这里好荒凉，我害怕……你能...

say:11:1321825009:0.text: Of course. But before we return, would you mind if we stopped by the temple?
say:11:1321825009:0.source_cn: 好，我陪你回去。但在回去之前，你愿意和我们一起去一趟雪...

say:13:1321825011:1.text: We're preparing a resting place for your parents there, so they may receive the blessings of the Divine Light.
say:13:1321825011:1.source_cn: 我们会在那里给你的父母找一处被圣光祝福的安眠之地。

say:15:1321825013:0.text: Mr. Faramor, please... take care of her.
say:15:1321825013:0.source_cn: 法拉莫尔先生，请你……照顾好她。

say:17:1321825015:1.text: Come on, Orla. It's slippery here, you have to watch your steps.
say:17:1321825015:1.source_cn: 走吧，奥尔嘉。小心点，这里有些滑。

choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 你还是很重视家族传承的

choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 我还以为你会说家族也是虚无呢
